notes: *And when* is one rendering of the opening waw under rule 55, headed on the coordinator; the corpus records eleven units headed on *when* instead. The apodosis waw before *she came* is then left with no connective and is unrepresented under rule 14.

The two attributive articles on הָרָצִים and הַמְהַלְלִים are unrepresented, the ASV writing the participles bare (rules 29, 41). The margin's alternative rendering of the participles was read and set aside (rule 38).
